name: Dumbbell Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one foot holding a dumbbell in front of your chest and extend your free leg straight forward.
Brace your core, sit your hips back, and bend the standing knee into a deep single-leg squat.
Keep the extended foot clear of the floor and drive firmly through your standing foot to rise.
Complete the working leg, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your standing heel planted flat as your knee tracks over your toes.
Hold the dumbbell slightly forward as a counterbalance and descend only as deep as you can control.
